title.narrative: Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation Corridor 3 (Bishkek-Osh Road) Improvement Project, Phase 4

description.narrative: The project will improve national and regional connectivity by reconstructing and rehabilitating an estimated 120 km of crucial road sections between Bishkek and Osh, and will include road safety measures such as road signs, lane markings, street lighting, parking areas, bus stops, crash barriers, and sidewalks. The impact of the project will be enhanced regional connectivity and trade via CAREC Corridor 3. The outcome will be improved efficiency and safer movement of goods and people on the Bishkek-Osh road. The project outputs will be (i) 52.5 km of rehabilitated road from Bishkek to Kara Balta, (ii) 67 km of rehabilitated road from Madaniyat to Jalalabad, (iii) strengthened road asset management system, and (iv) improved road safety.

description.narrative: Improved efficiency and safer movements of goods and people on the Bishkek-Osh Road

Reduced travel time between Bishkek and Kara-Balta of 18% (40 minutes) by 2024 (baseline: 50 minutes in 2013) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Indicator will be assessed in Q4 2024. Data Source: MOTR report

Use of roads upgraded in the first full year of operation increased to 2,057,000 average daily vehicle-km in 2024 (baseline: 1,430,000 in 2013) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Indicator will be assessed in Q4 2024. Data Source: MOTR report
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Institutional capacity strengthened Indicator: 68.5 km pilot PBM contract completed by 2020 (baseline: 0 km in 2013) Achievement: 68.5 Progress/Status: The contractor completed the total works on 31 December 2020. The 68.5 km road is under routine maintenance by DEU9. Data Source: MOTR project progress report

Output: Road from Bishkek to Kara-Balta reconstructed Indicator: 52.5 km of road reconstructed with pavement international roughness index reduced to 3.0 meters per km by 2023 (baseline: 7.0 meters per km in 2013) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: (i) 45.1 km road section was reconstructed and handed over to MOTC on 29 November 2021. As of 22 July 2024, the progress is 100% complete.
(ii) 7.4 km section: As of 22 July 2024, the progress is 100% complete. The Contractor has completed repairing the defects found by the Working Commission. State handover of project road is under preparation. Data Source: MOTR project progress report
